catalysts.headline: FDA granted accelerated approval of VOCERYQ (a plasmid DNA immunotherapy delivered with Inovio's CELLECTRA 5PSP device) to reduce the frequency of surgery in adults with recurrent respiratory papillomatosis (RRP) -- Inovio's first-ever FDA-approved product. Approval is based on the RRP-001 study (32 adult patients). FDA requires a confirmatory trial; Inovio must submit a draft protocol by end of 2026. Company guides to shipping availability in ~60 days and full commercial launch in Q1 2027.
